name: Sequence tools
description: Sequence maths for the assistant, the API and pipelines, and the sequence block with its workbench: edit and annotate, restriction enzymes and digests with a gel, primers and PCR, cloning plans, guide RNAs, codon tools and Sanger checks.
author: Sheetbase

operations.title: Find restriction sites
operations.description: Lists where restriction enzymes cut a DNA sequence: the enzyme, its site, how many times it cuts and the cut positions. Names no enzymes means all known ones.

inputs.name: sequence
inputs.description: DNA letters; spaces, digits and a FASTA header line are ignored.

inputs.name: topology
inputs.description: linear or circular (circular if left out).

inputs.name: enzymes
inputs.description: Enzyme names such as EcoRI, BsaI. Leave out for all.

inputs.name: unique_only
inputs.description: Only enzymes that cut once.

operations.title: Digest a sequence
operations.description: Cuts a DNA sequence with restriction enzymes and gives the fragments with their sizes and sticky ends, and the bands a gel would show.

inputs.name: sequence
inputs.description: DNA letters; spaces, digits and a FASTA header line are ignored.

inputs.name: topology
inputs.description: linear or circular (circular if left out).

inputs.name: enzymes
inputs.description: Enzyme names such as EcoRI, BamHI.

operations.title: Annotate a sequence
operations.description: Finds common elements (promoters, tags, sites, sequencing primers) and open reading frames in a DNA sequence.

inputs.name: sequence
inputs.description: DNA letters; spaces, digits and a FASTA header line are ignored.

inputs.name: topology
inputs.description: linear or circular (circular if left out).

operations.title: Design primers
operations.description: Designs PCR primer pairs that amplify a region of a DNA sequence, with melting temperatures, GC and warnings. Optional tails are added to the 5' ends.

inputs.name: sequence
inputs.description: DNA letters; spaces, digits and a FASTA header line are ignored.

inputs.name: start
inputs.description: First base of the region, 1-based.

inputs.name: end
inputs.description: Last base of the region, 1-based.

inputs.name: target_tm
inputs.description: Best melting temperature in °C (60 if left out).

inputs.name: max_product
inputs.description: Longest product in bases (2000 if left out).

inputs.name: forward_tail
inputs.description: Bases to add to the 5' end of the forward primer.

inputs.name: reverse_tail
inputs.description: Bases to add to the 5' end of the reverse primer.

operations.title: Check a primer
operations.description: Gives a primer's length, melting temperature, GC, clamp, hairpin and self-dimer strength, and warnings.

inputs.name: primer
inputs.description: Primer bases, 5' to 3'.

operations.title: Simulate PCR
operations.description: Finds the products two primers would make on a template, tails included.

inputs.name: template
inputs.description: DNA letters; spaces, digits and a FASTA header line are ignored.

inputs.name: forward
inputs.description: Forward primer, 5' to 3'.

inputs.name: reverse
inputs.description: Reverse primer, 5' to 3'.

inputs.name: topology
inputs.description: linear or circular (circular if left out).

operations.title: Assemble parts in silico
operations.description: Joins DNA parts by digest and ligate, Golden Gate or Gibson assembly and gives the products with the order and orientation of the parts and their junctions.

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: ligation, golden_gate or gibson.

inputs.name: parts
inputs.description: A list of parts: {name, sequence, topology (linear or circular), enzymes and pick for ligation}.

inputs.name: enzyme
inputs.description: Golden Gate: the Type IIS enzyme, such as BsaI.

operations.title: Align two sequences
operations.description: Aligns two DNA sequences (globally, or the best local match) and gives the score, identity, matches, mismatches and gaps.

inputs.name: reference
inputs.description: DNA letters; spaces, digits and a FASTA header line are ignored.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: DNA letters; spaces, digits and a FASTA header line are ignored.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: global or local (local if left out).

operations.title: Find CRISPR guides
operations.description: Lists guides next to the nuclease's PAM on either strand, with GC, a simple quality screen and a count of near matches in the same sequence. Check a chosen guide against the genome before ordering.

inputs.name: sequence
inputs.description: DNA letters; spaces, digits and a FASTA header line are ignored.

inputs.name: topology
inputs.description: linear or circular (circular if left out).

inputs.name: nuclease
inputs.description: spcas9, sacas9 or cas12a (spcas9 if left out).

inputs.name: start
inputs.description: Only guides inside this region: first base, 1-based.

inputs.name: end
inputs.description: Last base of the region.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Most guides to return, best first (20 if left out).

operations.title: Optimise codons
operations.description: Rewrites a coding sequence, or a protein, with the codons a host uses most, and can steer clear of restriction sites and long single-base runs.

inputs.name: sequence
inputs.description: A coding sequence (DNA) or a protein.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: dna or protein.

inputs.name: host
inputs.description: ecoli, human or yeast.

inputs.name: avoid_enzymes
inputs.description: Enzymes whose sites should not appear.

inputs.name: max_run
inputs.description: Break single-base runs this long (6 if left out, 0 to leave alone).

operations.title: Check a Sanger read
operations.description: Checks a Sanger read against the sequence you meant to make: which strand, where it covers, and each difference with its quality.

inputs.name: expected
inputs.description: The expected sequence.

inputs.name: read
inputs.description: The Sanger read bases.

inputs.name: quality
inputs.description: Phred scores as text, one character per base (score + 33). Leave out to treat every base as Q40.

inputs.name: topology
inputs.description: linear or circular (circular if left out).

operations.title: Fingerprint a sequence
operations.description: Gives the registry fingerprint of a sequence: the same text from either strand, any start of a circle, whatever the letter case.

inputs.name: sequence
inputs.description: The sequence letters.

inputs.name: molecule
inputs.description: dna, rna or protein (dna if left out).

inputs.name: topology
inputs.description: linear or circular (circular if left out).

sameness-keys.title: Same sequence
sameness-keys.description: Two entries are the same when their sequence is the same, read from either strand and, for a circle, from any start.

blocks.title: Sequence
blocks.description: A DNA, RNA or protein sequence with its map and the tools to work on it.
